title: 正交異性鋼橋面板製作~Orthotropic steel deck fabrication
focus: 以面板厚度、肋—面板部分滲透焊、焊接變形與組裝精度控制，製作能承受數億次輪載的輕量鋼橋面~Deck-plate thickness, rib-to-deck partial-penetration welds, distortion and fit-up control that produce a light steel deck able to survive hundreds of millions of wheel passes
summary: 從輪載經面板、縱肋、橫梁到主梁的局部與整體傳力出發，以疲勞為主控計算面板厚度，再處理 U 形肋冷彎、肋—面板部分滲透焊、面板單元焊接變形、工地拼接收縮、非破壞檢測與試拼裝，最後以鋪面協同、疲勞熱點檢查與裂縫成長評估交接，並以金門大橋 1982 至 1986 年換裝鋼橋面、Lions Gate 橋與 Millau 高架橋為案例。~Starting from the local and global load path from wheel to deck plate, ribs, floorbeams and main girders, size the deck plate with fatigue governing, then handle cold-formed U-ribs, rib-to-deck partial-penetration welds, panel welding distortion, site-splice shrinkage, non-destructive testing and trial assembly, and finally hand over with surfacing interaction, fatigue hot-spot inspection and crack-growth assessment, using the Golden Gate Bridge's 1982–1986 redecking, Lions Gate and Millau as cases.

units.anchor: 面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力~Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path
units.title: 正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力~Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck
units.mechanism: 正交異性鋼橋面由一片薄鋼面板、與其焊接的密排縱肋，以及間隔數公尺的橫梁組成，兩個方向勁度不同，故名正交異性。輪載先使面板在相鄰肋腹板之間局部受彎，再由縱肋把荷重以連續梁方式傳到橫梁，橫梁再傳到主梁或箱梁腹板；同時整片面板與縱肋又是主梁的上翼板，承受整體彎曲的縱向應力。這種一板多用的設計使橋面重量遠低於混凝土橋面，因此長跨懸索橋、斜張橋與活動橋普遍採用，但也意味著每一處焊接細部都承受局部與整體應力的疊加。~An orthotropic steel deck consists of a thin steel deck plate, closely spaced longitudinal ribs welded to it and floorbeams a few metres apart, with different stiffness in the two directions, hence the name. A wheel load first bends the deck plate locally between adjacent rib webs; the ribs then carry the load as continuous beams to the floorbeams, which pass it to the main girders or box webs. At the same time the deck plate and ribs act as the top flange of the main girder, carrying longitudinal stress from global bending. This multiple use makes the deck far lighter than concrete, so long suspension, cable-stayed and movable bridges widely adopt it, but it also means every welded detail sees local and global stresses superimposed.
units.model: 輪載 P = 75 kN、輪印長 0.4 m，面板在肋腹板間跨距 s = 0.3 m 以兩端固定板條計：w = 75×(0.3/0.4)/0.3 = 187.5 kN/m，M = w·s²/12 ≈ 1.41 kN·m；面板 16 mm 時 S = 0.4×0.016²/6 ≈ 1.71×10⁻⁵ m³，σ ≈ 82 MPa；12 mm 時 σ ≈ 146 MPa，增加約 78%。數值為教學假設。~For a wheel load P = 75 kN on a 0.4 m long patch and a deck plate spanning s = 0.3 m between rib webs as a fixed-ended strip, w = 75×(0.3/0.4)/0.3 = 187.5 kN/m and M = w·s²/12 ≈ 1.41 kN·m; with a 16 mm plate S = 0.4×0.016²/6 ≈ 1.71×10⁻⁵ m³ and σ ≈ 82 MPa; with 12 mm, σ ≈ 146 MPa, about 78% more. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 設計時以局部有限元素模型（殼元素，含輪印與鋪面）計算面板、肋—面板焊縫與肋—橫梁連接的應力，與手算板條模型比較量級；並在整體模型中取出同一位置的整體縱向應力，檢查兩者疊加後的設計值與疲勞應力幅。~At design stage, compute stresses in the deck plate, rib-to-deck welds and rib-to-floorbeam connections with a local shell finite-element model including the wheel patch and surfacing, compare the order of magnitude with the hand strip model, and take the global longitudinal stress at the same location from the global model to check the superimposed design value and fatigue stress range.
units.failure: 只用整體模型設計主梁、把橋面板視為均勻翼板，會漏掉輪載下面板的局部彎曲；早期採用較薄面板的橋梁，常在重車道輪跡下方出現沿肋—面板焊縫的縱向疲勞裂縫，並使上方鋪面開裂。~Designing the main girders with a global model alone, treating the deck as a uniform flange, misses local plate bending under wheels; early decks with thinner plates often developed longitudinal fatigue cracks along rib-to-deck welds beneath heavy-lane wheel paths, cracking the surfacing above.
units.misconception: 鋼橋面板只是主梁的上翼板，只要整體彎曲應力合格即可。~A steel deck plate is just the top flange of the girder, so passing the global bending check is enough.
units.practice: 設計報告須同時提供整體與局部模型的關鍵細部應力表，並標示重車道與輪跡位置；製造廠的焊接程序與檢驗計畫必須依這些關鍵細部分級，而不是對所有焊縫一視同仁。~The design report must give tables of key detail stresses from both global and local models and mark heavy lanes and wheel paths; the fabricator's welding procedures and inspection plan must be graded by these key details rather than treating every weld alike.

units.anchor: 肋—面板焊縫應力幅~Rib-to-deck weld stress range
units.title: 疲勞主控的面板厚度選擇~Fatigue-governed choice of deck-plate thickness
units.mechanism: 正交異性橋面的設計通常不是由強度控制，而是由疲勞控制：每一個重車輪通過都在面板與焊縫產生一次應力循環，百年內次數可達數億。焊接細部的疲勞壽命依 S–N 曲線與應力幅的三次方成反比，而面板局部彎曲應力約與厚度平方成反比，所以面板稍微加厚，壽命就大幅增加。FHWA 2012 年手冊把面板最小厚度提高到 14 至 16 mm 列為近年改進之一，正是早期薄面板疲勞經驗的反映。~Orthotropic deck design is usually governed not by strength but by fatigue: every heavy wheel causes one stress cycle in the plate and welds, adding up to hundreds of millions over a century. Welded-detail fatigue life is inversely proportional to the cube of stress range on the S–N curve, while local plate bending stress varies roughly with the inverse square of thickness, so a slightly thicker plate greatly extends life. FHWA's 2012 manual lists raising the minimum deck-plate thickness to 14 to 16 mm among recent improvements, reflecting the fatigue experience of early thin plates.
units.model: S–N：N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³，取細部類別 Δσ_C = 71 MPa。16 mm 面板應力幅 45 MPa：N ≈ 2×10⁶×(71/45)³ ≈ 7.9×10⁶；改用 12 mm，應力幅乘 (16/12)² ≈ 1.78 成為 80 MPa，N ≈ 1.4×10⁶，壽命只剩約 1/5.6。數值為教學假設。~S–N: N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³ with a detail category Δσ_C = 71 MPa. A 16 mm plate with a 45 MPa stress range gives N ≈ 2×10⁶×(71/45)³ ≈ 7.9×10⁶; a 12 mm plate multiplies the stress range by (16/12)² ≈ 1.78 to 80 MPa, giving N ≈ 1.4×10⁶, about 1/5.6 of the life. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 依規範疲勞荷載模型（重車軸重、橫向分布與車流量）計算關鍵細部的應力幅頻譜，以 Miner 累積損傷檢核設計年限；新型細部或沒有規範類別的細部，須以足尺疲勞試驗驗證，試體的焊接程序必須與量產一致。~Compute stress-range spectra at key details from the code fatigue load model (axle loads, transverse distribution and traffic volume) and check the design life by Miner's cumulative damage; new details without a code category need full-scale fatigue tests whose specimens are welded with the same procedure as production.
units.failure: 以強度為主決定面板厚度、再事後補做疲勞檢核，常發現重車道細部壽命不足，只能局部加厚或更換細部，造成設計與製造反覆；若完全忽略疲勞，裂縫可能在通車十多年內就出現在輪跡下方。~Sizing the plate for strength and checking fatigue afterwards often reveals insufficient life at heavy-lane details, forcing local thickening or detail changes and design–fabrication rework; ignoring fatigue entirely can let cracks appear beneath wheel paths within a decade or two of opening.
units.misconception: 鋼橋面板只要強度足夠，疲勞可以等出現裂縫再處理。~If the steel deck is strong enough, fatigue can be dealt with once cracks appear.
units.practice: 業主規範應明訂面板最小厚度、縱肋最小厚度與關鍵細部的疲勞類別，並要求新細部須有試驗依據；設計審查時把疲勞計算列為必審項目，而不是附錄。~Owner specifications should set minimum deck-plate and rib thicknesses and fatigue categories for key details, require test evidence for new details, and treat fatigue calculations as a mandatory review item rather than an appendix.

units.anchor: U 形縱肋冷彎成型~Cold-formed U-ribs
units.title: 閉口 U 形肋與鋼材選擇~Closed U-ribs and steel selection
units.mechanism: 現代正交異性橋面多採閉口梯形或 U 形縱肋，由 6 至 10 mm 鋼板冷彎成型，抗扭勁度高，能把輪載分散到相鄰肋，且每延公尺需要的焊縫比開口肋少。冷彎時外緣纖維產生很大的塑性應變，會降低鋼材韌性並可能出現微裂，因此彎曲內半徑、鋼材的韌性等級與彎後檢查都要事先規定。閉口肋內部無法進入，所以肋的兩端要封閉或做好防蝕，肋本身的直線度與開口寬度也直接決定日後與面板的組裝間隙。~Modern orthotropic decks mostly use closed trapezoidal or U-shaped ribs cold-bent from 6 to 10 mm plate, with high torsional stiffness that spreads wheel loads to neighbouring ribs and fewer welds per metre than open ribs. Cold bending puts large plastic strain in the outer fibres, which reduces toughness and can cause micro-cracks, so the inner bend radius, the steel's toughness grade and post-bending inspection must be specified in advance. The inside of a closed rib is inaccessible, so its ends must be sealed or protected against corrosion, and the rib's straightness and opening width directly govern the later fit-up gap to the deck plate.
units.model: 冷彎外緣應變 ε ≈ t/(2r_i + t)。肋厚 t = 8 mm、內半徑 r_i = 4t = 32 mm：ε = 8/(64 + 8) ≈ 11%。U 肋頂寬 300 mm、底寬 180 mm、高 300 mm 時，斜腹板長 √(300² + 60²) ≈ 306 mm，展開寬約 180 + 2×306 ≈ 792 mm，每公尺重 0.792×0.008×7,850 ≈ 49.7 kg。數值為教學假設。~Outer-fibre bending strain ε ≈ t/(2r_i + t). For t = 8 mm and r_i = 4t = 32 mm, ε = 8/(64 + 8) ≈ 11%. A U-rib 300 mm wide at the top, 180 mm at the bottom and 300 mm deep has sloping webs √(300² + 60²) ≈ 306 mm long, a developed width of about 180 + 2×306 ≈ 792 mm and a weight of 0.792×0.008×7,850 ≈ 49.7 kg per metre. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 鋼板進廠核對出廠證明的化學成分、強度與衝擊韌性；冷彎後抽查彎角處的磁粉或滲透檢測、開口寬度、腹板角度與全長直線度，並與允差比較；首批產品以切片確認彎角內外表面沒有裂紋。~On receipt, check mill certificates for chemistry, strength and impact toughness; after bending, spot-check bends by magnetic-particle or dye-penetrant testing and measure opening width, web angle and full-length straightness against tolerances; for the first batch, section samples to confirm no cracking on the inside or outside of the bends.
units.failure: 內半徑過小或鋼材韌性不足，彎角外側出現微裂紋，日後在交通載重下成為疲勞起始點；肋開口寬度超差，與面板組裝時間隙不均，部分滲透焊的熔深隨之忽深忽淺。~Too small a bend radius or insufficient toughness creates micro-cracks on the outside of bends that later initiate fatigue under traffic; ribs with out-of-tolerance opening widths give uneven gaps at fit-up, so the penetration of the partial-penetration weld varies along the rib.
units.misconception: 縱肋只是加勁板，用一般鋼板隨意冷彎即可。~Ribs are mere stiffeners and can be cold-bent from any ordinary plate.
units.practice: 採購規格須訂明肋用鋼材的韌性等級、最小彎曲內半徑與彎後檢查頻率；每批肋件以批號追蹤到面板單元，確保發現問題時能回溯。~Procurement must specify the rib steel's toughness grade, minimum inner bend radius and post-bending inspection frequency; each batch of ribs is traced by lot number to its panels so any problem can be traced back.

units.anchor: 肋—面板部分滲透焊~Rib-to-deck partial-penetration weld
units.title: 肋—面板焊縫與橫梁開孔細部~Rib-to-deck welds and floorbeam cut-out details
units.mechanism: 閉口肋只能從外側焊接，所以肋—面板焊縫是單面部分滲透焊：熔深太淺，未熔合的根部像一道預存裂縫，在輪載反覆下由根部向面板或焊趾成長；熔深太深則燒穿，在肋內形成焊瘤與缺口。FHWA 手冊強調此焊縫須控制熔深且不得燒穿。肋穿過橫梁時，橫梁腹板常在肋底部留下開孔，讓肋在輪載下能有限度地轉動，降低肋—橫梁焊縫的拘束應力；開孔形狀、焊縫包角與切割面品質都是疲勞敏感處。~A closed rib can only be welded from outside, so the rib-to-deck weld is a one-sided partial-penetration weld: too shallow and the unfused root acts as a built-in crack that grows under repeated wheel loads into the deck plate or toe; too deep and it melts through, leaving drop-through and notches inside the rib. FHWA's manual stresses controlled penetration with no melt-through. Where ribs pass through floorbeams, the floorbeam web usually has a cut-out below the rib so the rib can rotate a little under wheel loads, reducing restraint stresses in the rib-to-floorbeam weld; cut-out shape, weld wrap-around and cut-edge quality are all fatigue-sensitive.
units.model: 肋壁 8 mm，若目標熔深 80% 為 6.4 mm、下限 70% 為 5.6 mm。潛弧焊熱輸入 Q = V·I·60/(1,000·v)：30 V、600 A、行進速度 500 mm/min，Q = 30×600×60/(1,000×500) = 2.16 kJ/mm；速度降到 400 mm/min 時 Q 升為 2.7 kJ/mm，熔深加大、燒穿風險上升。數值為教學假設。~With an 8 mm rib wall, an 80% penetration target is 6.4 mm and a 70% minimum is 5.6 mm. Submerged-arc heat input Q = V·I·60/(1,000·v): at 30 V, 600 A and 500 mm/min, Q = 30×600×60/(1,000×500) = 2.16 kJ/mm; slowing to 400 mm/min raises Q to 2.7 kJ/mm, deepening penetration and increasing the risk of melt-through. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 焊接程序評定須以實際肋與面板組合做試焊，切取多個斷面做巨觀蝕刻量測熔深與根部形狀；量產時依規定頻率（例如每一面板單元的端部延伸段）切取試片，並以相位陣列超音波沿線檢查熔深，與程序評定結果比較。~Welding procedure qualification must use real rib and plate assemblies, sectioning several locations for macro-etch measurement of penetration and root shape; in production, cut test pieces at the specified frequency, for example from run-off extensions on each panel, and scan penetration along the weld with phased-array ultrasonics for comparison with the qualification.
units.failure: 組裝間隙忽大忽小，固定焊接參數下熔深隨之變化，間隙大處燒穿、間隙小處熔深不足；開孔切割面粗糙或焊縫包角不完整，橫梁腹板在開孔端部出現疲勞裂縫並向腹板內擴展。~With a gap that varies along the rib and fixed welding parameters, penetration varies with it: melt-through where the gap is large and too little penetration where it is tight; rough cut-out edges or incomplete weld wrap-around let fatigue cracks start at cut-out ends and grow into the floorbeam web.
units.misconception: 肋—面板焊縫焊得越深越好，最好完全燒穿。~The deeper the rib-to-deck weld the better; full melt-through is best.
units.practice: 肋—面板焊接應以自動化設備、固定姿勢與經評定的參數施焊，組裝間隙在焊前逐段檢查並記錄；開孔以數控切割並規定表面粗糙度與研磨要求，關鍵焊縫的焊工資格與參數紀錄須可追溯。~Rib-to-deck welds should be made with automated equipment in a fixed position with qualified parameters, with fit-up gaps checked and recorded section by section before welding; cut-outs are CNC cut with specified roughness and grinding, and welder qualifications and parameter records for key welds must be traceable.

units.title: 面板單元製作與焊接變形控制~Panel fabrication and welding distortion control
units.mechanism: 面板單元通常是數公尺寬、十餘公尺長的面板配上數根 U 肋，大量長焊縫集中在面板一側，焊後冷卻收縮會使面板縱向彎曲並在肋間產生橫向角變形。若不控制，面板單元在組成箱梁時無法密合，工地拼接間隙不均，鋪面也難以平整。工廠常用反變形胎架把面板預先彎成與焊接收縮方向相反的形狀，配合對稱焊接順序與夾具，使焊後回彈到設計形狀；必要時再以火焰矯正，但火焰矯正溫度須受控，以免改變鋼材性質。~A panel unit is usually a deck plate a few metres wide and over ten metres long with several U-ribs, concentrating many long welds on one side; cooling shrinkage bows the panel longitudinally and causes angular distortion between ribs. Uncontrolled, panels will not fit when assembled into box girders, site-splice gaps become uneven and the surfacing is hard to finish flat. Shops use pre-cambered jigs that bend the panel opposite to the weld shrinkage, together with symmetrical welding sequences and clamps, so it springs back to the design shape; flame straightening may follow if needed, but its temperature must be controlled so the steel's properties are not altered.
units.model: 寬 3.6 m、16 mm 面板配 6 根 8 mm U 肋，中性軸在面板下約 0.073 m，I ≈ 1.15×10⁻³ m⁴。12 道焊縫各產生 120 kN 收縮力，合計 1,440 kN，作用在面板高度，彎矩 M ≈ 1,440×0.073 ≈ 105 kN·m；12 m 長單元的拱度 δ = M·L²/(8EI) = 105×12²/(8×2.1×10⁸×1.15×10⁻³) ≈ 7.9 mm，胎架預彎量以此為初值。數值為教學假設。~For a 3.6 m wide, 16 mm plate with six 8 mm U-ribs, the neutral axis lies about 0.073 m below the plate and I ≈ 1.15×10⁻³ m⁴. Twelve weld lines each shrinking with 120 kN give 1,440 kN at plate level, M ≈ 1,440×0.073 ≈ 105 kN·m; over a 12 m unit the bow is δ = M·L²/(8EI) = 105×12²/(8×2.1×10⁸×1.15×10⁻³) ≈ 7.9 mm, the starting value for the jig pre-camber. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 首批面板單元焊前、焊後與冷卻後以三維量測記錄縱向拱度、肋間角變形與面板平整度，與預測比較並修正胎架預彎量與焊接順序；量產後每一單元出廠前量測並與允差比較，火焰矯正區域記錄位置與溫度。~For the first panels, survey longitudinal bow, angular distortion between ribs and plate flatness in 3D before welding, after welding and after cooling, compare with prediction and adjust the jig pre-camber and welding sequence; in production, measure every unit before dispatch against tolerances and record the location and temperature of any flame straightening.
units.failure: 未使用反變形或焊接順序不對稱，面板單元扭曲成馬鞍形，組裝箱梁時以強力拉合，留下很大的殘餘應力；過度火焰矯正則使局部鋼材過熱，韌性下降，日後成為脆性破壞或疲勞的起點。~Without pre-camber or with unsymmetrical welding, panels twist into a saddle shape and are forced together during box assembly, locking in large residual stresses; excessive flame straightening overheats the steel locally, lowering toughness and creating a starting point for brittle fracture or fatigue.
units.misconception: 焊接變形可以等組裝時再用千斤頂硬拉回來。~Welding distortion can simply be pulled out with jacks during assembly.
units.practice: 製造計畫須包含胎架設計、焊接順序圖、變形量測點與允差、火焰矯正溫度上限與方法，並經業主審查；變形量測結果應建檔，作為後續批次修正的依據。~The fabrication plan must include jig design, welding-sequence drawings, distortion measuring points and tolerances, and flame-straightening temperature limits and methods, reviewed by the owner; distortion records are filed as the basis for correcting later batches.

units.anchor: 肋拼接嵌補段~Rib splice insert
units.title: 工地拼接與焊接收縮預留~Site splices and shrinkage allowance
units.mechanism: 面板單元在工廠組成箱梁節段後，於工地或預拼場對接：面板以單面焊加陶瓷襯墊做全滲透對接焊，縱肋則因無法從內部焊接，常以一段短的嵌補肋在兩端與既有肋對接，或改用高強度螺栓拼接板。每一道橫向對接焊冷卻時都會縮短一點，數十道累積起來就可能讓整跨鋼梁長度不足，因此節段製作長度必須預留收縮量。拼接順序也很關鍵：先焊面板再焊縱肋，或反之，會產生不同的拘束應力。~Panels are assembled into box segments in the shop and joined on site or in a pre-assembly yard: the deck plate gets one-sided full-penetration butt welds on ceramic backing, while ribs, which cannot be welded from inside, are usually joined with a short insert rib welded at both ends to the existing ribs, or with high-strength bolted splice plates. Each transverse butt weld shortens a little as it cools, and dozens of them can leave a whole span short, so segment fabrication lengths must include a shrinkage allowance. Splice sequence also matters: welding the deck plate first or the ribs first produces different restraint stresses.
units.model: 主跨 360 m 由 30 道橫向工地對接組成，每道對接焊收縮約 1.5 mm，累積 30×1.5 = 45 mm；節段放樣須平均每段加長 1.5 mm，否則跨中閉合缺口約 45 mm，需另行加長嵌補段。數值為教學假設。~A 360 m main span with 30 transverse site butt joints, each shrinking about 1.5 mm, shortens by 30×1.5 = 45 mm; each segment must be laid out 1.5 mm longer on average, otherwise the midspan closure gap is about 45 mm short and needs a longer insert. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以工廠試焊量測實際橫向收縮量，作為放樣加長的依據；工地拼接前量測兩節段端面的間隙、錯邊與肋的對位，焊後量測收縮並更新累積值；面板對接焊以超音波或射線檢測，嵌補肋焊縫以磁粉檢測加超音波檢查。~Measure actual transverse shrinkage on shop trial welds as the basis for the layout allowance; before each site splice, measure gap, misalignment and rib registration at the two segment faces, measure shrinkage after welding and update the running total; test deck butt welds by ultrasonics or radiography and insert-rib welds by magnetic particle plus ultrasonics.
units.failure: 沒有預留收縮或只依理論值預留，最後的閉合段長度不符，只能現場切割或加長鋼板；嵌補肋焊縫在工地仰焊或立焊條件差，根部缺陷多，成為通車後最早出現疲勞裂縫的位置之一。~Making no shrinkage allowance, or relying on theory alone, leaves the final closure the wrong length, forcing site cutting or added plate; insert-rib welds made overhead or vertical in poor site conditions have many root defects and are among the first places to crack by fatigue after opening.
units.misconception: 工地對接焊只會影響局部，不會改變整跨長度。~Site butt welds are local and do not change the length of a whole span.
units.practice: 工地焊接須有防風、防雨與預熱措施，焊接程序與焊工須在工地條件下評定；收縮累積表由製造廠與架設單位共同維護，閉合段長度在最後量測後才放樣切割。~Site welding needs wind, rain and preheat protection, with procedures and welders qualified under site conditions; the shrinkage tally is kept jointly by fabricator and erector, and the closure piece is laid out and cut only after the final measurement.

units.anchor: 相位陣列超音波~Phased-array ultrasonic testing
units.title: 焊縫非破壞檢測與熔深驗證~Non-destructive testing and penetration verification
units.mechanism: 正交異性橋面的焊縫數量以公里計，檢測策略必須分級：面板與主要對接焊做全長超音波或射線檢測；肋—面板部分滲透焊因為根部本來就不熔合，傳統超音波難以區分刻意的未熔合與缺陷，所以需要相位陣列超音波量測熔深，並以巨觀蝕刻試片校正；角焊縫與開孔端部則以目視與磁粉檢測表面裂紋。檢測結果必須與焊接參數紀錄連結，才能找出系統性問題，例如某一台焊機或某一班次的熔深偏低。~Welds on an orthotropic deck run to kilometres, so inspection must be graded: deck-plate and main butt welds get full-length ultrasonic or radiographic testing; rib-to-deck partial-penetration welds have an intentionally unfused root that conventional ultrasonics struggle to distinguish from defects, so phased-array ultrasonics measure penetration, calibrated against macro-etch specimens; fillet welds and cut-out ends are checked visually and by magnetic particle for surface cracks. Results must be linked to welding-parameter records to reveal systematic problems such as low penetration from a particular machine or shift.
units.model: 肋壁 t = 8 mm，相位陣列超音波量得未熔合根部高度 1.8 mm，熔深比例 (8 − 1.8)/8 = 77.5%，高於 70% 下限；若量得 2.6 mm，熔深 (8 − 2.6)/8 = 67.5%，低於下限須評估補焊。數值為教學假設。~For a rib wall t = 8 mm, a phased-array measurement of a 1.8 mm unfused root gives a penetration ratio of (8 − 1.8)/8 = 77.5%, above the 70% minimum; a 2.6 mm reading gives (8 − 2.6)/8 = 67.5%, below the minimum, requiring a repair assessment. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 相位陣列超音波系統以含已知熔深的參考試塊校正，並與同批巨觀蝕刻試片交叉比對；檢測人員須具相應資格，掃描資料連同位置與焊接參數存檔；不合格位置的補焊程序須另行評定並重新檢測。~Calibrate the phased-array system on reference blocks of known penetration and cross-check against macro-etch specimens from the same batch; inspectors must hold the relevant qualification, and scan data are archived with position and welding parameters; repairs at rejected locations need their own qualified procedure and re-inspection.
units.failure: 只以目視檢查外觀良好的肋—面板焊縫，無法發現熔深不足，問題要到通車多年後鋪面沿肋線開裂才浮現；檢測資料與焊接紀錄分開保存，則無法判斷缺陷是個別偶發還是整批參數錯誤。~Visual checks of a neat-looking rib-to-deck weld cannot reveal shallow penetration, which surfaces only years after opening as surfacing cracks along the rib lines; keeping inspection data apart from welding records makes it impossible to tell an isolated defect from a whole batch welded with wrong parameters.
units.misconception: 焊縫外觀平滑、尺寸合格，就代表內部熔深足夠。~A smooth weld of the right size must have adequate penetration inside.
units.practice: 檢驗計畫應列出每一類焊縫的檢測方法、比例與允收標準，第三方檢驗須獨立於製造廠；檢測發現系統性問題時，啟動停工、追溯與擴大抽檢的程序，並經業主同意後恢復生產。~The inspection plan should list method, extent and acceptance criteria for each weld type, with third-party inspection independent of the fabricator; a systematic problem triggers a stop, traceback and extended sampling, and production resumes only with owner approval.

units.title: 試拼裝與幾何量測~Trial assembly and geometric survey
units.mechanism: 鋼箱梁節段離開工廠前，常把相鄰兩至三個節段在預拼場依設計線形擺放，確認端面間隙、面板錯邊、縱肋對位、拼接板孔位與整體預拱，必要時在工廠內修正，避免到了海上或高空才發現對不上。正交異性橋面的關鍵是縱肋與面板在拼接處的錯邊：對接處的偏心會使局部應力集中，直接縮短疲勞壽命。三維雷射掃描或全站儀量測把每一節段的實際幾何建成數位模型，供架設時模擬閉合。~Before leaving the shop, two or three adjacent box segments are often laid out in the pre-assembly yard on the design alignment to check end gaps, deck-plate misalignment, rib registration, splice-plate hole positions and overall camber, correcting problems in the shop rather than discovering them at sea or at height. For orthotropic decks the key item is misalignment of ribs and plates at splices: eccentricity at a butt joint concentrates local stress and directly shortens fatigue life. 3D laser scanning or total-station surveys build a digital model of each segment's real geometry for simulating closure during erection.
units.model: 板件對接錯邊 e 造成的彎曲應力集中係數 SCF ≈ 1 + 3e/t。肋壁 t = 8 mm：錯邊 1 mm 時 SCF ≈ 1 + 3×1/8 = 1.375；錯邊 2 mm 時 SCF ≈ 1.75。以 m = 3 的 S–N 曲線，壽命比約 (1.375/1.75)³ ≈ 0.48，錯邊加倍壽命約減半。數值為教學假設。~Misalignment e at a plate butt joint gives a bending stress concentration factor SCF ≈ 1 + 3e/t. For an 8 mm rib wall, 1 mm misalignment gives SCF ≈ 1 + 3×1/8 = 1.375 and 2 mm gives SCF ≈ 1.75. With an m = 3 S–N curve the life ratio is about (1.375/1.75)³ ≈ 0.48, so doubling the misalignment roughly halves the life. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 試拼裝時以全站儀或雷射掃描量測每個端面的面板高程、肋位置與間隙，逐肋記錄錯邊並與允差比較；整體預拱與平面線形以設計座標比對，結果製成節段幾何報告，隨節段出廠交給架設單位。~During trial assembly survey each face's deck-plate levels, rib positions and gaps by total station or laser scanning, record misalignment rib by rib against tolerance, compare overall camber and plan alignment with design coordinates, and issue a segment geometry report that travels with the segment to the erector.
units.failure: 省略試拼裝，到了架設現場才發現縱肋錯位數公釐，只能以強制對位或加墊板處理，在拼接處留下錯邊與附加應力；拼接板孔位不符時現場擴孔，削弱摩擦型螺栓接合的性能。~Skipping trial assembly lets ribs arrive several millimetres out of register, forcing them together or shimming and leaving misalignment and added stress at splices; mismatched splice holes are reamed on site, weakening slip-critical bolted joints.
units.misconception: 只要每個節段尺寸各自合格，到現場一定能順利對接。~If every segment is individually within tolerance, they will always fit on site.
units.practice: 合約應規定試拼裝的範圍與頻率、錯邊與間隙允差，以及不符合時的修正程序；節段幾何報告與數位模型屬於竣工資料的一部分，供日後檢查與維修使用。~The contract should define trial-assembly extent and frequency, misalignment and gap tolerances and the correction procedure for non-conformance; segment geometry reports and digital models form part of the as-built records for later inspection and repair.

units.title: 鋪面系統與面板協同作用~Surfacing system and composite action with the plate
units.mechanism: 正交異性橋面的鋪面不只是行車表面：它把輪載分散到較大面積，並在低溫時與鋼面板部分合成，顯著降低面板與焊縫的應力幅；同時保護鋼面板免受水與鹽侵蝕。金門大橋 1980 年代換裝的鋼橋面採用約 2 吋（約 50 mm）的環氧瀝青鋪面。鋪面的勁度隨溫度大幅改變，夏季高溫時合成效果降低，面板應力上升；鋪面開裂或與鋼板脫層，則同時失去分散荷載與防水兩種功能。~The surfacing on an orthotropic deck is more than a running surface: it spreads wheel loads over a larger area and, when cold, acts partly compositely with the steel plate, markedly reducing stress ranges in the plate and welds, while protecting the plate from water and salt. The Golden Gate Bridge's 1980s steel deck received about 2 inches (about 50 mm) of epoxy asphalt. Surfacing stiffness changes greatly with temperature, so composite action drops in hot summers and plate stresses rise; cracking or debonding of the surfacing loses both load spreading and waterproofing.
units.model: 16 mm 鋼面板加 50 mm 鋪面，假設完全合成：鋪面模數 5,000 MPa（約常溫）時板條抗彎勁度約為鋼板單獨的 5.3 倍；高溫降到 1,000 MPa 時只剩約 1.9 倍；低溫 10,000 MPa 時約 9.1 倍。勁度比的變化說明夏季重車造成的應力幅最大。數值為教學假設。~For a 16 mm steel plate with 50 mm of surfacing assumed fully composite, a surfacing modulus of 5,000 MPa at moderate temperature gives a strip bending stiffness about 5.3 times that of the plate alone; at 1,000 MPa in hot weather only about 1.9 times; at 10,000 MPa in cold weather about 9.1 times. The variation shows why heavy trucks in summer cause the largest stress ranges. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 鋪設前檢查鋼面板噴砂等級、粗糙度與防蝕底漆，鋪面材料做配比與黏結強度試驗；鋪設後以拉拔試驗抽查與鋼板的黏結，並以敲擊或熱像檢查脫層；通車初期在面板下方貼應變計量測不同季節的應力幅，驗證設計假設。~Before paving, check blast grade, roughness and primer on the steel plate and test the surfacing mix and bond strength; after paving, spot-check bond by pull-off tests and look for debonding by sounding or thermography; in the first years, gauge the plate underside to measure stress ranges in different seasons and verify design assumptions.
units.failure: 鋼板表面處理不良，鋪面在數年內大面積脫層，水分積在鋪面與鋼板之間，造成鋼板腐蝕與鋪面推擠；若設計時以低溫勁度計入合成作用，夏季實際應力幅高於預期，疲勞裂縫提早出現。~Poor surface preparation lets the surfacing debond over large areas within a few years, trapping water between surfacing and plate, corroding the steel and shoving the surfacing; counting cold-weather composite stiffness in design underestimates summer stress ranges and brings fatigue cracking forward.
units.misconception: 鋪面只是行車面，壞了換新就好，與鋼橋面疲勞無關。~Surfacing is just a wearing course, unrelated to deck fatigue, and can simply be replaced when worn.
units.practice: 鋪面系統（防蝕層、黏結層、鋪面）應與鋼橋面一起設計與驗收，規格中明訂適用溫度範圍與黏結強度；維護計畫須包括鋪面裂縫的即時封填，避免水分進入鋼板界面。~Design and accept the surfacing system (corrosion layer, bond coat, surfacing) together with the steel deck, specifying the temperature range and bond strength; the maintenance plan must include prompt sealing of surfacing cracks so water cannot reach the steel interface.

units.anchor: 疲勞熱點檢查清單~Fatigue hot-spot checklist
units.title: 疲勞檢查、裂縫成長與交接~Fatigue inspection, crack growth and handover
units.mechanism: 正交異性橋面的疲勞裂縫集中在少數已知位置：肋—面板焊縫根部向面板內成長、肋—橫梁連接與開孔端部、嵌補肋拼接焊縫、面板對接焊。根部向面板成長的裂縫從上方被鋪面遮住、從箱內看不到焊縫內部，往往要到鋪面沿肋線開裂才被發現。因此交接時必須提供以熱點為主的檢查清單、箱內通行路線、可用的超音波檢測方法，以及依裂縫成長速度訂定的檢查週期；修復可用止裂孔、螺栓補強板或橋面加鋪高性能混凝土層。~Fatigue cracks in orthotropic decks concentrate at a few known locations: rib-to-deck weld roots growing into the deck plate, rib-to-floorbeam connections and cut-out ends, insert-rib splice welds and deck-plate butt welds. Root cracks growing into the plate are hidden by surfacing from above and invisible inside the weld from within the box, so they are often found only when the surfacing cracks along rib lines. Handover must therefore supply a hot-spot inspection checklist, access routes inside the box, suitable ultrasonic methods and inspection intervals based on crack-growth rates; repairs include stop holes, bolted doubler plates or an overlay of high-performance concrete on the deck.
units.model: Paris 定律 da/dN = C·(ΔK)³，ΔK = Y·Δσ·√(πa)，C = 3×10⁻¹³（mm 與 MPa√mm）、Y = 1.12、Δσ = 40 MPa。裂縫由 2 mm 長到 12 mm：N = 2(a₀^−0.5 − a₁^−0.5)/[C·(YΔσ)³·π^1.5] ≈ 5.6×10⁶ 次；若重車輪每日 3,000 次，約 5.1 年。數值為教學假設。~Paris law da/dN = C·(ΔK)³ with ΔK = Y·Δσ·√(πa), C = 3×10⁻¹³ (mm and MPa√mm), Y = 1.12 and Δσ = 40 MPa. Growing a crack from 2 mm to 12 mm takes N = 2(a₀^−0.5 − a₁^−0.5)/[C·(YΔσ)³·π^1.5] ≈ 5.6×10⁶ cycles, about 5.1 years at 3,000 heavy wheel passes a day. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 交接前完成一次基準檢查：箱內熱點逐一目視與磁粉檢測、重車道肋—面板焊縫以超音波抽查、鋪面裂縫圖與照片；之後的檢查週期依裂縫成長計算與實際交通量設定，每次結果與基準比較，新裂縫須記錄位置、長度與方向。~Before handover complete a baseline inspection: every hot spot inside the box checked visually and by magnetic particle, heavy-lane rib-to-deck welds sampled by ultrasonics, and the surfacing crack map photographed; set later intervals from crack-growth calculations and actual traffic, compare every result with the baseline, and record the position, length and direction of any new crack.
units.failure: 沒有熱點清單與基準資料，檢查人員在箱內只看塗裝與鏽蝕，面板根部裂縫持續成長，直到穿透面板使鋪面局部塌陷；修補時若只封填鋪面裂縫而不處理鋼板裂縫，問題會在下一個夏季重現。~Without a hot-spot list and baseline, inspectors inside the box look only at coating and rust while root cracks keep growing until they penetrate the plate and the surfacing locally collapses; sealing the surfacing crack without repairing the steel crack brings the problem back the next summer.
units.misconception: 鋼橋面疲勞裂縫一出現就表示整座橋面必須立即更換。~Once a fatigue crack appears, the whole steel deck must be replaced immediately.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含關鍵細部清單與疲勞計算、焊接與檢測紀錄、節段幾何報告、鋪面系統資料、箱內通行與照明配置及檢查週期；重車道交通量顯著增加時，管理單位應通知結構顧問重新評估檢查週期。~Handover documents should contain the key-detail list and fatigue calculations, welding and inspection records, segment geometry reports, surfacing data, box access and lighting layout and inspection intervals; if heavy-lane traffic rises markedly, the owner should ask the structural consultant to re-evaluate the intervals.

example: 設計取捨練習：一座寬 30 m、長 1,000 m 的鋼橋面（面積 30,000 m²），比較面板厚度 12、16、18 mm。局部彎曲應力約與厚度平方成反比：由 12 mm 改為 16 mm，應力幅降為 (12/16)² ≈ 0.56 倍，以 m = 3 的 S–N 曲線計，疲勞壽命約增為 (16/12)⁶ ≈ 5.6 倍；增加的鋼重為 0.004 m × 7,850 kg/m³ = 31.4 kg/m²，全橋約 31.4×30,000/1,000 ≈ 942 t。再由 16 mm 加到 18 mm，應力幅降為 (16/18)² ≈ 0.79 倍，壽命約增為 (18/16)⁶ ≈ 2.0 倍，增重 15.7 kg/m²，全橋約 471 t。若再考慮常溫鋪面合成可使板條勁度增為約 5.3 倍、夏季高溫只剩約 1.9 倍，設計應以高溫狀態檢核重車道細部。結論：在重車道使用較厚面板、在輕載區維持標準厚度，是兼顧重量與疲勞的常見作法。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。~Trade-off exercise: a steel deck 30 m wide and 1,000 m long (30,000 m²) compares deck plates of 12, 16 and 18 mm. Local bending stress varies roughly with the inverse square of thickness: going from 12 mm to 16 mm cuts the stress range to (12/16)² ≈ 0.56 times, so with an m = 3 S–N curve the fatigue life rises about (16/12)⁶ ≈ 5.6 times; the added steel is 0.004 m × 7,850 kg/m³ = 31.4 kg/m², about 31.4×30,000/1,000 ≈ 942 t for the bridge. Going on from 16 mm to 18 mm cuts the stress range to (16/18)² ≈ 0.79 times and raises life about (18/16)⁶ ≈ 2.0 times for 15.7 kg/m², about 471 t. Allowing for surfacing composite action, which raises strip stiffness about 5.3 times at moderate temperature but only about 1.9 times in summer heat, heavy-lane details should be checked for the hot condition. Conclusion: thicker plates in heavy lanes and standard thickness elsewhere is a common balance of weight and fatigue. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
history: 德國工程師 Wilhelm Cornelius 於 1948 年提出以正交異性鋼橋面建造懸索橋並建立分析方法，戰後德國重建的大量鋼橋使這種輕量橋面迅速成熟。1975 年溫哥華 Lions Gate 橋北側高架段以正交異性鋼橋面取代混凝土橋面，是北美首例；1982 至 1986 年金門大橋在不封閉道路的情況下，利用 401 個夜間把原混凝土橋面分 747 段換成正交異性鋼橋面，橋面重量減輕約 12,300 噸（美噸）。早期部分橋面的肋—面板焊縫出現疲勞裂縫，促使業界提高面板厚度並控制焊縫熔深，FHWA 於 2012 年出版正交異性鋼橋面設計、施工與維護手冊整合這些經驗；2004 年通車的 Millau 高架橋則擁有面積極大的正交異性鋼橋面。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~German engineer Wilhelm Cornelius proposed a suspension bridge with an orthotropic steel deck in 1948 and developed methods to analyse it, and Germany's post-war rebuilding of many steel bridges quickly matured this light deck. In 1975 the north viaduct of Vancouver's Lions Gate Bridge replaced its concrete deck with an orthotropic steel deck, the first in North America; from 1982 to 1986 the Golden Gate Bridge replaced its concrete deck in 747 sections over 401 nights without closing the roadway, cutting deck weight by about 12,300 US tons. Fatigue cracks at the rib-to-deck welds of some early decks led the industry to thicker deck plates and controlled weld penetration, experience that FHWA consolidated in its 2012 manual on the design, construction and maintenance of orthotropic steel deck bridges, while the Millau Viaduct, opened in 2004, carries a very large orthotropic deck. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: FHWA 2012 年手冊把面板最小厚度提高到約 14 至 16 mm（9/16 至 5/8 in）列為近年改進~FHWA's 2012 manual lists raising the minimum deck plate to about 14 to 16 mm (9/16 to 5/8 in) as a recent improvement

金門大橋換裝鋼橋面後橋面重量減輕約 12,300 美噸，每延英尺約 1.37 美噸，鋪面為約 2 吋環氧瀝青~The Golden Gate redecking cut deck weight by about 12,300 US tons, about 1.37 tons per linear foot, with about 2 inches of epoxy asphalt

Millau 高架橋全長 2,460 m、橋面寬 28 m、梁高 4.20 m，鋼材總量約 50,000 t~The Millau Viaduct is 2,460 m long with a 28 m wide, 4.20 m deep deck and about 50,000 t of steel
